summary: Surveyed all 1336 .lean files of the unit: 1327 under papers/<paper>/ across 44 paper directories plus 40 top-level papers/*.lean roots, 3 under papers/TEMPLATE, 3 under scripts/. A declaration-keyword grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque|macro|syntax|notation) found 73 files with no such keyword; I inspected the non-import content of all 73. Most are paper root import aggregators, export/compatibility re-export surfaces (e.g. EOS07GSP/MainTheorems.lean exports ~500 paper_theorem names, KR21Monoculture/Basic.lean re-exports ranking lemmas), or per-paper Assumptions.lean ledgers carrying namespaces and assumption documentation; these stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007/FD-016 and FILTER-021. The largest files (GN21DriverSurgePricing/MainTheorems.lean 5.7MB with 4633 theorem/lemma lines, LG21TestOptionalPolicies/MainTheorems.lean 1179, LMMS04FairDivision/MainTheorems.lean 565, EOS07GSP/AuctionMainTheorems.lean 1276) are genuine proof files. Excluded: the three papers/TEMPLATE files, which are one block comment each stating they intentionally contain no mathematical declarations, and two small scripts/ Lean metaprogramming audit commands with no mathematical content. The 183 KB scripts/lean_signature_manifest_helper.lean is also audit tooling but I did not read it completely, so it is retained.
